last_codex_audit.note: Both High findings and all three Medium findings were real and have been fixed in the same commit that records this entry: (1) WeatherHeroChip showed a temperature with no visible station/freshness provenance (a colour dot + mouse-only `title` -- invisible on touch, and short of CurrentConditionsCard's own explicit station-identity rule) -- now shows a real (truncated-if-needed) station name/distance and a visible freshness word, with the full sentence also in `aria-label`. (2) This file itself (and IMPLEMENTATION_LOG.md) had not been updated in the same commit as 30 tracked files' worth of visual-rebuild changes -- this entry is that fix. (3) MapHero's `fr-fields` GeoJSON source was only ever set once at mount, never updated on a later field/tone change -- now kept in sync via `setData` in the same effect that already re-runs on `[fields, selectedFieldId]`. (4) ActivityTimelineCard grouped/keyed by its own display label (`dayLabel`, no year), which could merge or duplicate-key entries from different years sharing a day-of-year -- grouping/keying now uses a real `YYYY-MM-DD` `dayKey`, with the display label unchanged except now always including the year for the non-Today/Yesterday case. (5) MapHero disabled Mapbox's own attribution control entirely (`attributionControl: false`), which the logo control alone doesn't substitute for -- reverted to Mapbox's own default (enabled), matching FieldBoundaryMapModal's own untouched behaviour. Full account: docs/visual-audit/FINAL_VISUAL_ALIGNMENT_REPORT.md. This field is a pointer to the single most recent audit only, not a full history; this file must never carry two `last_codex_audit` keys.
